personalProjects.name: CERTifyTax Copilot
personalProjects.valueProposition: Internal AI knowledge assistant for enterprise tax operations and support teams.
personalProjects.problemSolved: Reduced time spent searching documentation, support contacts, migration procedures, IDT integration guidance, and exemption knowledge across CERTifyTax operations.
personalProjects.targetUsers: Dell tax operations, support, migration, integration, and internal product users.
personalProjects.solution: AI-powered internal copilot using RAG, structured knowledge, intent classification, routing, and support ownership discovery.
personalProjects.whyItMatters: Enabled conversational access to tax, support, integration, migration, and operational knowledge for enterprise users.
highlights: Led product vision, requirements, roadmap, validation governance, UAT, and beta rollout
Improved automated validation accuracy from 47% to 88%
Expanded RAG knowledge coverage across hundreds of enterprise support and process topics

personalProjects.name: Customer Readiness Platform
personalProjects.valueProposition: Enterprise readiness and compliance intelligence product for tax-exempt transaction onboarding.
personalProjects.problemSolved: Identifies gaps that prevent customers from becoming transaction-ready for tax-exempt processing across exemption data, customer master data, jurisdiction requirements, certificate status, and integration dependencies.
personalProjects.targetUsers: Dell tax operations, onboarding, support, compliance, and IT teams responsible for customer readiness and exemption processing.
personalProjects.solution: Readiness intelligence platform with automated assessments, certificate validity analysis, jurisdiction compliance checks, onboarding-readiness scoring, missing-data identification, dashboards, and remediation recommendations.
personalProjects.whyItMatters: Accelerates onboarding, reduces manual readiness reviews, improves compliance posture, lowers support escalations, and increases operational transparency.
highlights: Defined product vision, roadmap, requirements, workflows, and rollout strategy
Aligned Tax, Operations, and IT stakeholders around readiness scoring and remediation priorities
Introduced readiness intelligence across certificate, customer, jurisdiction, and integration dependencies

personalProjects.name: Exemption Analyzer
personalProjects.valueProposition: AI-powered tax exemption diagnostic and decision intelligence product for faster issue resolution.
personalProjects.problemSolved: Simplifies tax-exemption troubleshooting by identifying certificate, mapping, jurisdiction, customer, and integration problems affecting tax determination.
personalProjects.targetUsers: Dell tax operations, support analysts, compliance teams, integration teams, and business users handling exemption-related issues.
personalProjects.solution: AI-assisted diagnostic workflow covering root-cause analysis, certificate diagnostics, TaxCalc and IDT validation, mapping analysis, legal-entity and jurisdiction validation, recommendations, and guided troubleshooting.
personalProjects.whyItMatters: Reduces investigation effort, speeds up issue resolution, improves support efficiency, reduces processing delays, and strengthens audit and compliance visibility.
highlights: Led product strategy, business case, problem discovery, and user research
Designed AI-assisted diagnostic workflows for exemption issue triage and decision support
Owned prioritization, feature definition, cross-functional delivery, and adoption planning
